qualifications: These maxima cover measured primary phase owners; they do not measure every TypeWorkBudget owner.
CoreBuilder construction and rewrite budgets are separate and absent from the six endpoints; final-elaboration emits before builder.finish.
Independent Core currently derives three times TYPE_WORK_LIMIT. A separate budget requires coherent decoupling of the validator, calibration override and driver labels.
The strict ten-percent hard margin applies to each rounded nominal budget. Rounding headroom is separate and makes the ceiling more than ten percent above measured maxima.
For a generic integer budget use budget + budget/10, without rounding the fractional margin upward. Sum no cumulative module endpoints.
Constraint, usefulness, runtime and unreported owners remain separate; ordinary-limit e2e completion is required to establish delivery.
No CPU-to-work-unit or memory-to-work-unit conversion is made.
